sources.title: STACK Infrastructure: POR03 - Hillsboro campus page (version modified 27 August 2026)
sources.summary: STACK's POR03 page ('POR03 - Hillsboro') states: 'STACK's Portland campus in Hillsboro delivers digital infrastructure engineered for AI, ML, and cloud workloads. The 55-acre campus provides approximately 200MW of total critical capacity, including 25MW with near term availability, 96MW of expansion capacity, and 72MW of operational critical capacity'. It lists 200MW, 55 acres and 6 buildings, and the campus data centers POR03A (182,000 sq ft, 24MW), POR03B (180,000 sq ft, 24MW), POR03C (180,000 sq ft, 24MW), POR03D (198,000 sq ft, 25MW) and POR03E/F (530,000 sq ft, 96MW). The present-tense statement of 72 MW of operational critical capacity records existing data-centre operations on the POR03 campus; the 72 MW equals the stated ratings of POR03A-C, while POR03D's 25 MW 'near term availability' and the 96 MW POR03E/F 'expansion capacity' are not operating claims and are excluded.
